chunks: Abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام.
About a man who transfers a debt to another man: can he revert back against him? He عليه السلام said: “He does not revert back against him ever, unless he had become bankrupt before that.”

key_terms.بِالْمَالِ: with respect to property or debt owed
key_terms.يَرْجِعُ: returns with a claim against the original debtor
key_terms.يُحِيلُ: transfers a debt or liability from one party to another

ai.seo_question: Can a creditor return to the original debtor after a debt transfer in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the transfer of debt liability. Once the debt has been validly transferred, the creditor cannot return to the original debtor, except when the transferee had already been bankrupt beforehand.
